fact: The director of addressing at the Ministry of Construction, Housing and Urban Planning said on 30 September 2025 that addressing of the Abidjan district (about 17,000 roads identified, 500,000 entities to receive addresses, FCFA 12bn project financed by the World Bank and the State) is due to finish on 31 December 2025 and is being duplicated nationally, with about fifteen cities to be addressed by 2030.

The Ministry of Construction, Housing and Urban Planning says the Abidjan street addressing project met on 4-5 April 2024 to begin effective implementation of the address database, presented as the official address reference.

fact: A data-sharing framework agreement for the Abidjan District addressing project (PADA) was signed on 24 January 2023, to give addresses and name all streets across the district's 13 communes (AIP).
